Tathāgatassa’nadhivarassa.g: ettha ayaṁ saṅkhepattho–tathā āgamanādi-atthena Tathāgatassa sadevake loke aggabhāvato anadhivarassa Sammāsambuddhassa amatapadaṁ asaṅkhataṁ nibbānaṁ uddissa desitattā, amatassa vā nibbānassa paṭipajjanupāyattā kenacipi asaṅkharaṇīyattā ca amatapadaṁ asaṅkhataṁ sāsanaṁ saddhammaṁ

Tathāgatapadaṁitipī.g: idaṁ sikkhattayasaṅgahaṁ sāsanabrahmacariyaṁ Tathāgatagandhahatthino paṭipattidesanāgamanehi kilesagahanaṁ ottharitvā gatamaggotipi.

Tathāgatapadaṁitipi.g: idaṁ sikkhattayasaṅgahaṁ sāsanabrahmacariyaṁ Tathāgatagandhahatthino paṭipattidesanāgamanehi kilesagahanaṁ ottharitvā gatamaggotipi.

Tathāgatasāvaka.g: ettha Paccekabuddhā navahi lokuttaradhammehi sayaṁ tittā paripuṇṇā, aññe pana tappetuṁ na sakkonti.
